FIELDS.NAME: Grace Community Church
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Facilities Manager, 123 Faith Lane, Springfield, IL 62704-1234, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: john.smith@gracecommunitychurch.org
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Grace Community Church, we focus on providing spiritual support, community engagement, and outreach programs. Our core operations include weekly worship services, youth and adult education programs, and various community service initiatives. We prioritize the safety and well-being of our congregation and have established child protection policies and background checks for all staff and volunteers, minimizing risks associated with abuse or negligence. Our facilities are well-maintained, equipped with up-to-date safety systems, and comply with local health and fire safety regulations. We host events and gatherings while ensuring proper supervision and safety protocols are in place. By fostering a welcoming environment, we aim to build a strong sense of community and provide a safe space for worship and fellowship.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Community outreach programs, including a thrift store and food pantry operated on-site for charitable support.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a severe storm caused water damage to the church's basement, resulting in repair costs of $5,000. The repairs have been completed, and the situation is now resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday; 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM, Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1, UL Listed Safe.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and regular patrol by volunteers during service hours.
